description: Na₂UO₄ is (La,Ba)CuO4 structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-O bond lengths. U is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.93 Å) and four longer (2.18 Å) U-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent U atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₄U₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
